items.title: Charles Tolliver interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 6, 2021 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: I’m struck by the fact that you mentioned showing up for this rehearsal and oh my God, there’s Roy Haynes and Herbie Hancock

ctx.x: But it was how he equalized everything coming in you know.

I see. Well I’m struck by the fact that you mentioned showing up for this rehearsal and oh my God, there’s Roy Haynes and Herbie Hancock, who actually was only — fairly close to age to you. And I just find it so interesting —
Well he was 24, 23, 24. And me 21 or 22 you know.
